title: Moisture chamber goggles for the treatment of postoperative dry eye in patients receiving SMILE and FS-LASIK surgery

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: myopia (inclusion: SE -2.50 to -20.00 D, astigmatism up to -5.00 D, age 18-40 years); nonrandomized open-label controlled study of moisture chamber goggles for refractive-surgery-related dry eye

groups.description: SMILE (VisuMax 500 kHz) with standard postoperative drops (tobramycin-dexamethasone, calf blood extract gel, sodium hyaluronate); Table 1 n = 22 participants; abstract: 78 participants (156 eyes) enrolled, i.e. both eyes
SMILE plus moisture chamber goggles (at least half of the day for 1 month) in addition to the standard postoperative drops; sequential allocation; Table 1 n = 21 participants
FS-LASIK (VisuMax 500 kHz flap, 90-100 um, Schwind Amaris 179 excimer) with standard postoperative drops; Table 1 n = 17 participants
FS-LASIK plus moisture chamber goggles for 1 month in addition to the standard postoperative drops; Table 1 n = 18 participants

series.notes: mean ± SD; visits PreOp, PO 1 day, 1 week, 1 month; n = eyes (22 participants x 2, both eyes per abstract; the article does not state whether means are over eyes or participants); per-visit n not reported
mean ± SD; n = eyes (21 participants x 2); Tab2!R4C12 is printed without the ± sign (two numbers run together), its leading number is read; per-visit n not reported
mean ± SD; n = eyes (17 participants x 2); per-visit n not reported
mean ± SD; n = eyes (18 participants x 2); per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: same preoperative reference as the PreOp columns of Tab2/Tab3 (not duplicated)
figure; the same visits are tabulated

notes: Refraction: tables label MRSE = manifest refractive spherical equivalent; Methods: preoperative manifest and cycloplegic refraction by autorefractometer (RM-800, Topcon), manifest refraction at follow-ups; only MRSE is tabulated, method recorded as manifest.
Target refraction not stated (recorded as unstated).
Participants unable to complete the preoperative examination or more than one follow-up were excluded from the analyses (attendance-based, not outcome-defined; kept).
UCVA/BCVA (logMAR), NIBUT, TMH, congestion, lipid layer (AvgICU, DevICU), total HOA, coma, spherical aberration, secondary astigmatism, trefoil and OSDI are tabulated (Tab1-Tab3); not extracted.
